When I did that test it was with HBAO set to Ultra

9070 XT

32GB DDR5 ram

Ryzen 7600x

This mod overwrites the ambient occlusion setting in tarkov’s graphics settings. So if you set to max performance then GTAO will use less samples and be less expensive.
